name: BACH_0053_FSIM_resample3
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (63%)** · Unreliable input · Careful review
Resampled frozen section is out-of-distribution [F6], cannot separate InSitu from Benign [F1], and defers margins [F7].

## Confidence
|Signal | Value | Reading|
|---|---|---|
|Top probabilities | InSitu 63%, Benign 33%, Normal 2%, Invasive 2% | InSitu leads; invasive risk 2%|
|Conformal set | Benign, InSitu (90% coverage) | Cannot separate Benign from InSitu|
|Reliability / OOD | 30% reliability; 100th OOD percentile | Flagged; resampled frozen section suspect|
|CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree on top class | Independent foundation models split|
|Similar cases | 20% match (1/5 InSitu) [F5] | Weak support; nearest is Benign|

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 1) · ↓ invasive · Low score (-0.42) pushes away from invasive [F2] · Validated
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Low score (0.03) pushes toward invasive; 0/20 spot-checked [F3] · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 4) · ↑ invasive · Typical score (0.42) nudges toward invasive [F4] · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; top-risk region deletion drops invasive probability above random (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion CI -0.0088–0.0064 spans 0); uses unreliable normal_lobules and mitoses (0/20 AI spot-checked).

## Could be wrong if
- Resample degradation (severity 3, 100th OOD percentile) distorts morphology; recut H&E and deeper levels are drafted.
- Lesion is Benign like nearest case BACH_0230 (82% similarity; differs in unreliable mitoses and weak TILs).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 2, 1, 5**: Highest risk tiles (38%, 27%, 18%); check duct-confined atypia (region 5) versus invasion (region 1).
2. **Regions 1, 10, 8**: Highest superior (100%), inferior (90%), and medial (79%) margin segments; permanent-section deferral drafted.
3. **Regions 8, 4**: Check lobular architecture and stroma; judge whether frozen-section artifact requires the drafted recut.
